newsitem.title: SPAIN: ATHLETICS-GUERRA ENDS BROWN'S WINNING STREAK.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-GUERRA ENDS BROWN'S WINNING STREAK.

text.p: Portugal's Paul Guerra pulled away 500 metres from the line to win the men's 9.905-km world cross challenge event on Sunday and end Briton Jon Brown's four-race winning streak.
The 1995 European cross country champion finished in 19 minutes 57 seconds with last year's European champion Brown second and Kenya's world champion Paul Tergat third.

The race was staged in appalling conditons with torrential rain before and during the event. At various points on the course around Roman ruins near the southern Spanish City, the athletes waded through water almost a metre deep.
The standings are still led by France's Yann Millon, who did not compete on Sunday.
Millon has 57 points while South African Hendrick Ramaala moved up to second with 54 points despite finishing only 14th.
Romania's Elena Fidatov won her third consecutive race in this season's series.
Fidatov, 36, finished the 5.664-km women's race in 20:26 with Ethiopia's world championm Gete Wami, coming home second in 20:31.
Spain's Julia Vaquero was third in 20:33 to repeat the top three positions from the last race held a week ago in Amorebieta, also in Spain.
Fidatov takes over from Wami at the top of the women's rankings. The Romanian has 97 points after five races, while Wami is second with 88 points.
The next race is in Tourcoing, France, on February 1.
